The clause reads as channel integrity across delay.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001008/B002","root_001545/B002"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-3","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_681d7c4f3692517d94d4","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"14:47:9\",\"root_001008\",[\"B002\"]],[\"14:47:11\",\"root_001545\",[\"B002\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Üstün güç, dönüşümden bireysel hesaba uzanan ölçülü karşılık verme işlemleriyle etkili hâle gelir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_001662/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_722c03edef0e8550c18d","text":"2. **A promise can await its appointment without failing it.** `و ع د B001` supplies a promise opening expectation, and `خ ل ف B005` failure to arrive at the appointed time, here negated. 14:44 centers term and postponement; 14:48 begins the promised transformation day. I infer that timing distinguishes deferral from breach. `مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ` is denied because the expected event reaches, rather than misses, its appointed boundary.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000433/B005","root_001662/B001"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-2","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_76779e3582cda9456280","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"14:47:4\",\"root_000433\",[\"B005\"]],[\"14:47:5\",\"root_001662\",[\"B001\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"İlahî söz bekleyebilir, fakat açtığı beklentinin belirlenmiş vaktine ulaşmayarak boşa çıkmaz.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000318/B002"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-1","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_9ebe78aa2000e39cc2c7","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"14:47:2\",\"root_000318\",[\"B002\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"İkinci sanma yasağı, gecikmiş uygulamayı sözden dönme sayan aynı yanlış çıkarımı düzeltir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_001008/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_a684847c7a6f3267f1e8","text":"3. **Might becomes operational as matched requital.** `ع ز ز B002` supplies overcoming and subduing, and `ن ق م B002` punitive requital. The next four ayat enact transformation, binding, combustible covering, and recompense matching what each self earned. The packet supplies epithet followed by operations; I infer that requital is the assigned role through which might becomes visible. `عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَام` reads as effective enforcement, not status language alone.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":[],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_cfe90a27666069340453","text":"Ayat 14:48–51 display fulfillment as a sequence—environmental replacement, exposure, binding, embodied consequence, and matched account—rather than one undifferentiated act.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000563/B002","root_001662/B001"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-4","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_d0d159d06879dfdc64ef","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"14:47:5\",\"root_001662\",[\"B001\"]],[\"14:47:6\",\"root_000563\",[\"B002\"]]],\"grade\":\"weak\",\"text\":\"Sözün elçilere bağlanması, yerine getirmenin kişilerin yanında onların taşıdığı iletişim kanalının güvenilirliğini de koruduğunu gösterir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000318/B002","root_001008/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_f435a30ad23dc0f988dd","text":"1. **Promise is measured by arrival, and power guarantees that arrival against plots.** `ح س ب` `B002` is mistaken supposition, `خ ل ف` `B005` a promise failing to reach its appointment, `و ع د` `B001` expectation-opening promise, `ر س ل` `B002` messenger/message, and `ع ز ز` `B002` overcoming power. The satanic failed promise in 14:22 supplies the exact contrast. I infer divine might's role is to prevent obstruction between utterance and appointed fulfillment. The ayah reads as delivery assurance for both promise and messenger.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001545/B001","root_001545/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_fa88f8cfa8247e5aca75","text":"2. **Requital is targeted rejection of what cannot be accepted.** `ن ق م` `B001` is rejecting/faulting and `B002` punitive requital.
